preconditions.description: The number of test cases t is an integer between 1 and 10^4 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(n, int) and 2 <= n <= 200000 for n in [int(line.strip()) for line in stdin_text.split('\n')[1::2] if line.strip()])
preconditions.description: For each test case, n is an integer between 2 and 2*10^5 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(len(p) == n and set(p) == set(range(1, n+1)) for n, p in zip([int(line.strip()) for line in stdin_text.split('\n')[1::2] if line.strip()], [list(map(int, line.strip().split())) for line in stdin_text.split('\n')[2::2] if line.strip()]))
preconditions.description: Each test case provides a permutation p of length n containing distinct integers from 1 to n.

preconditions.expression: sum([int(line.strip()) for line in stdin_text.split('\n')[1::2] if line.strip()]) <= 200000
preconditions.description: The sum of n over all test cases does not exceed 2*10^5.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly t lines, one for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(int(line), int) for line in output_lines)
postconditions.description: Each output line is a valid integer representing the minimum number of operations.

postconditions.expression: all(min_ops(p) == int(output_lines[i]) for i, p in enumerate([list(map(int, line.strip().split())) for line in stdin_text.split('\n')[2::2] if line.strip()]))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output integer equals the minimum number of swaps required to transform the given permutation into one with exactly one inversion.
